title: On the complexity of the single-move labeled token routing problem
open: On a path, the order of the tokens never changes, so the sources left out can be chosen by dynamic programming along the path in polynomial time, although we do not know whether the linear running time of Theorem~ can be preserved. {Acknowledgements} Nicolas Bousquet was partly supported by ANR project ENEDISC (ANR-24-CE48-7768-01).

title: The structure of irreducible cuspidal eta quotients
open: We conjecture that the same assertion also holds in the other two cases: For MATH odd, there does not exist any primitive and irreducible holomorphic eta quotient which is a Fricke eigenform of level MATH.
